review.notes: Clean document, no patches. All 5 physical pages were rendered at 120 dpi and read against the OCR Markdown, and the full extracted PDF text was token-diffed against the Markdown in both directions with case/punctuation/bullet-glyph normalization; the only divergence is the cover-page corner line 'Model card updated March 2026' (p.1 furniture, matching the sibling lyria-3-5 handling, since the body carries 'Updated: March 2026'). No code fences in the OCR, so no fence-swallowing. Every sentence, heading, list item and bold field label on pages 2-4 matched the OCR word for word; page 5 is blank except for a rule and contributes nothing. The Distribution channels, evaluation types and Risks & Mitigations lists are complete and correctly ordered; the mixed marker glyphs are recorded under unresolved per the established bullet-style rule. The card contains no tables, footnotes, references or content figures; the only page-1 graphics are the Google logo and a decorative icon tile.

unresolved.evidence: Every list entry in the PDF prints with a filled-circle bullet (7 Distribution channels on p.3; 3 evaluation types and 6 Risks & Mitigations items on p.4). The OCR renders some entries as plain lines ('Gemini App', 'Google AI Studio', 'Google Vids', 'YouTube'), some with '\-' escapes ('Producer AI', the three evaluation types, 'dataset filtering', 'product-level mitigations') and some with '•'. Words are verbatim and no entry is missing, so per the established review rules marker glyph style alone is not patched.
